fields.label: Choose
options: Scheduled payment amount: Custom amount — Enter the amount of the scheduled payment you want the client to pay. Template discounts will not be applied.

fields.label: Registration fee
fields.help: The Registration fee will be charged when the booking is created and will be added to the price of the programme or the first scheduled payment.

fields.label: Include full start date
fields.help: Includes all sessions that occurred on the selected start date. If disabled, only sessions after that date are included.
